nodes.label: Bar-Line Cut Lock

attributes.rule: every shot start/end lands on a bar line of the measured 106 BPM / 60-bar grid
attributes.consequence: shot durations quantise to multiples of bar_sec 2.2642

nodes.rationale: Quantising every cut to a measured bar line makes the edit feel locked to the track regardless of which shots are later rewritten, and lets internal sub-cuts (S17, S23A, S23B) be specified as bar offsets rather than hand-timed frames.

nodes.label: Forced-Aligned Lyric Timeline (32 lines)

attributes.timing_provenance: MEASURED — whisper large-v3 forced alignment against the actual vocal audio, read as-is from 歌詞.srt
attributes.hook_lines: L03 '321 LIVE AI Li Li Live AI'; L12/L21 'LIVE AI 現在就創造未來'; L18/L32 'CSFCCA LIVE AI'

nodes.rationale: section and bar are computed against beatmap.json purely for readability and explicitly do not affect start/end — the aligned timings stay authoritative even if the section map is re-cut. Regenerate with scripts/align_lyrics.py.

nodes.label: LUNA Locked Costume Keywords

attributes.keywords: deep-violet high braided ponytail with silver chain accents; white sleeveless mock-neck zip crop top; white cargo mini-skirt with black belt and hanging chain; black thigh strap on left leg; chunky white platform sneakers with white crew socks; silver bracelets on right wrist

nodes.rationale: A fixed keyword list is carried into every generation prompt so independent per-panel/per-shot generation cannot drift on hair colour, outfit or accessories — the textual half of the consistency anchor whose visual half is the character sheet.

nodes.label: Six Hard-Cut Points

attributes.points_sec: 11.81 (bass entry), 45.77 (chorus 1 downbeat), 84.26 (breakdown, bass disappears), 93.32 (final chorus re-entry, highest novelty), 129.54 (outro collapse), 132.90 (final transient peak 0.96 — hold last frame)

nodes.rationale: Cut points are chosen from measured signal events (bass entry, dropout, novelty peak, final transient) rather than from the lyric or plan doc, so the edit lands on what the ear actually registers as a change.

nodes.label: 5000-Credit Floor Guard

attributes.procedure: call get_comic_api_usage first; stop if remaining credits < 5000

nodes.rationale: Per the LlamaGen guide, a pre-flight usage check with a hard stop below 5000 credits prevents a long batch run from exhausting the account mid-generation and leaving a half-rendered comic.

nodes.rationale: The manifest deliberately records the duration as an estimate with a note to re-measure, so downstream consumers know the value is provisional; beatmap.json later confirms the same 134.3 s by direct PCM decode.

nodes.label: ComfyUI MiniMax H3 Video Backend
nodes.rationale: All video shots were consolidated onto a single self-hosted ComfyUI MiniMax H3 workflow (env-overridable endpoint) rather than a mix of hosted video providers — one model choice keeps motion and style uniform across the whole cut and removes per-shot API cost.

nodes.label: Caption-Wins-Over-Lyric-Subtitle Rule

attributes.rule: captions are designed visual title cards; lyric subtitles come from lyrics/lyrics.srt; where both fall on the same shot the caption wins and the lyric subtitle yields
attributes.shots_with_captions: S05 'LIVE AI', S10 '那真的是我嗎？', S22 'LIVE AI', S24B 'See you on the next stage.'

nodes.rationale: Two independent text layers would collide on screen; declaring a fixed precedence (designed caption over generated subtitle) resolves it deterministically at compile time instead of per-shot judgement.

nodes.label: 後期統一調色為必要步驟（DaVinci Resolve / Premiere）

nodes.rationale: 不同 AI 模型輸出的色調與對比常有落差，多模型協作的直接代價就是必須用統一 LUT 或色彩分級收斂，不可省略。

nodes.label: AI 影片生成的角色一致性限制（本案最大風險）
nodes.norm_label: ai 影片生成的角色一致性限制(本案最大風險)
nodes.rationale: 2026 年的工具（含 Kling 3.0、Veo 3.1）仍做不到「上傳一張角色圖→全片完美一致」，長片段會臉部漂移、服裝細節跑掉；因此全案刻意採「分鏡短片段拼接」＋「參考圖逐鏡對應」，而不是一鏡到底生成整首 MV。

nodes.label: 多模型協作策略（依鏡頭類型分派）
nodes.norm_label: 多模型協作策略(依鏡頭類型分派)
nodes.rationale: 不同鏡頭類型交給最擅長的模型（寫實走位→Veo 3.1、舞蹈連續動作→Kling 3.0、快速篩選→Seedance 2.0、精確運鏡→Runway Gen-4.5），最後統一調色剪輯，而非依賴單一工具處理全片；代價是各模型色調不一，後期統一調色成為不可省略的步驟。

nodes.label: character_ref ＋ locked_keywords 一致性鎖
nodes.rationale: 每顆鏡頭都從 project.json 帶同一個 character_ref 與同一組 locked_keywords，所以單顆重生成不會讓其他鏡頭漂移 —— 這正是計畫書列為本案最大風險的一致性問題。兩個欄位都不可從鏡頭中刪掉。

nodes.label: 生成前的點數護欄（<5,000 停手）
nodes.norm_label: 生成前的點數護欄(<5,000 停手)
nodes.rationale: 任何生成前先呼叫 get_comic_api_usage，剩餘點數低於 5,000 就停；批次開跑前要取得明確同意，因為 LlamaGen 點數與 Claude Code 用量費用是分開計費的。

nodes.label: 角色一致性五項對策
nodes.rationale: 計畫書把一致性列為最大風險，分鏡的對應做法是：每顆鏡頭掛同一張 character sheet、表情只從九宮格挑（用到 8 種，生氣未用）、鎖定服裝關鍵字、先產 S12 當定裝鏡再拿它的輸出當其餘鏡頭參考圖、單顆鏡頭最長 9.1 秒以落在不會臉部漂移的安全區間。

nodes.label: 自架 ComfyUI MiniMax H3（S01–S24 統一模型）
nodes.norm_label: 自架 comfyui minimax h3(s01–s24 統一模型)
nodes.rationale: 分鏡改為自架 ComfyUI 的單一 workflow 統一處理所有舞蹈、敘事與轉場鏡頭，取代計畫書原本的多雲端模型分派 —— 24 顆鏡頭全部由同一模型產出，代價是失去各模型專長、換得色調與角色一致性以及不必跨平台匯出匯入。
